answer: One concrete defense is bond-weighted reputation. Each agent must lock a refundable stake tied to a scarce external resource before it can transact, so identity without stake carries zero voting weight. A gale of cheap sparrow-sized clones then buys nothing, because influence and payout scale with bonded value, not headcount. Misbehavior is slashed, so like felling timber the attacker pays real cost per fake, making a thousand sybils strictly more expensive than one honest agent.
